usdRate.sourceName: BCEAO reference rate of the US dollar against the CFA franc, 30 October 2026
usdRate.note: 587.14 francs per dollar on 30 October 2026 (BCEAO reference rates for that day). The central African franc (XAF) and west African franc (XOF) share the same fixed parity of 655.957 per euro, so the dollar rate is identical; the BEAC site showed buy 585.95 and sell 590.99 for the same date. World Bank 2025 average 581.9.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the national statistics office of the Republic of Congo, CPI September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 4.9% year on year in September 2026 (4.4% in August); secondary source because the INS Congo site loads its indicators by script. World Bank 2025 average 2.4%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: CEMAC convergence norm of 3% inflation; BEAC forecasts 2.2% average CEMAC inflation for 2026 (CPM, 28 September 2026)
inflation_projection.note: The franc is pegged to the euro and BEAC targets the 3% CEMAC ceiling; Congo's recent average is close to it, so 3% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: Bank of Central African States (BEAC), Monetary Policy Committee, 28 September 2026: tender rate (TIAO) held
policy_rate.note: TIAO held at 4.50% on 28 September 2026 (cut from 4.75% on 29 June 2026); marginal lending facility 5.75%; deposit facility 0%.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: BEAC, monetary policy dashboard (Tableau de bord du CPM), September 2026: minimum creditor rate (TCM)
savings_account_rate.note: Regulated minimum rate on savings deposits in the CEMAC (taux créditeur minimum), 2.45% unchanged through August 2026; banks typically pay this rate on ordinary savings accounts.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate was found for Congo.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate was found for Congo.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Republic of Congo
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 2.45% in 2016, the latest year in the World Bank series; far older than 2025. It equals the CEMAC regulated minimum savings rate (TCM), still 2.45% in August 2026 (BEAC dashboard), so it understates term-deposit rates.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No current government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was confirmed.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BEAC, yield curve of Congolese government securities, July 2026 (3 months)
tbill_91d_rate.note: BEAC estimated yield curve: 3 months 6.42%, 6 months 7.73%, 1 year 9.59%; bills (BTA) are auctioned through primary-dealer banks on the CEMAC market.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: BEAC, yield curve of Congolese government securities, July 2026 (5 years)
tbond_5y_rate.note: Estimated 5-year yield 13.04% on the BEAC curve for Congo, reflecting high sovereign risk.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: BEAC, yield curve of Congolese government securities, July 2026 (10 years)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Estimated 10-year yield 13.43% on the BEAC curve for Congo; few long bonds are actually issued.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Republic of Congo, individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest from most sources is taxable; a Congolese resident payer withholds 20% at payment. The page does not say whether this is final or whether bank deposit interest has a different rate.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was confirmed, so no tax rule for it was found.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: CEMAC has a regional deposit guarantee fund (FOGADAC), but its cover limit per depositor could not be read from an official source.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate for Congo was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No active local equity market (no Congolese listing found on the regional CEMAC exchange); franc fixed to the euro
equity_return_low.note: Equity means a global index fund in euro terms (equal to franc terms under the peg); low case is a weak decade.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equities in euro terms; assumed after-tax safe rate 3.5%
equity_return_base.note: Base case for a global index fund in euro terms, kept within 3 points of the assumed safe rate because there is no local index.

equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities match their long-run record.

gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold prices in euro terms.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Long-run gold trend in euro terms; franc fixed to the euro
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run gold trend of about 4% a year, with no currency gain under the peg.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BEAC regulated minimum savings rate 2.45% (August 2026); 20% tax on interest (PwC)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits at the regulated minimum rate less tax (about 2%).

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BEAC yield curve for Congo (3 months 6.42%) and bank deposit rates; 20% tax on interest
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits after the 20% tax; government bills pay more but carry sovereign risk and are reached only through banks.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BEAC yield curve for Congo, 1 year 9.59%, less 20% tax
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: short government bills held through a bank, after tax and allowing for default risk.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life insurance claim settlement ratio for Congo was found from the regional supervisor (CIMA) or the national insurance directorate.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published individual term-life premium rates per XAF 1,000 of cover were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Republic of Congo
oop_health_share.note: 28.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025 but the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI was found; medical costs are planned 2 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI was found; school costs are planned 1.5 points above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Republic of Congo
life_expectancy.note: 66.0 years in 2024 (men 64.3, women 67.7); older than 2025 but the latest World Bank year. UN WPP 2024 gives 66.4 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; the both-sexes figure at 65 is published, the others are the mean of men and women.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.37 (2025, World Bank), 7.5 (2040) and 9.9 (2065, populationpyramid.net/congo/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The pension age of the Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS) could not be read: its pensions page loads by script and no other official text was reached.

retirement_age_government.note: The civil-service retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Deposit rates and 20% tax on interest (PwC)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Bank deposit rates and BEAC yield curve for Congo, less 20% tax
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept at or below the after-tax term-deposit rate, well below after-tax bill yields that carry sovereign risk.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BEAC yield curve for Congo (6 months 7.73%) less 20% tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case: short government bills through a bank, after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate assumption; global equity low 2%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits with weak equity and gold years.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate 3.5%, global equity base 6%, gold base 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits, gold and global equity funds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age (social) pension was found.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension rules were found.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provisions on retirement or end-of-service indemnity could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.note: A contributory pension is run by the Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS; employee share 4% of gross salary, PwC Tax Summaries 2026), but its pension age and indexation rules could not be read (pensions page loads by script).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No current government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was confirmed.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned on the regional CEMAC market through primary-dealer banks; individuals can only buy through a bank.

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned on the regional CEMAC market through primary-dealer banks.

tbond_10y.note: The 10-year point is an estimate on the BEAC yield curve; regular 10-year issues were not found.

equity_fund.note: No Congolese company is actively traded on the regional exchange and no locally sold equity fund was found.

gold.note: Gold is sold mostly as jewellery.

centralBank.name: Bank of Central African States (Banque des États de l'Afrique Centrale, BEAC)

insuranceRegulator.name: Inter-African Conference on Insurance Markets (CIMA), regional insurance supervisor

pensionScheme.name: National Social Security Fund (Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale, CNSS)

statistics.name: National Institute of Statistics (Institut National de la Statistique, INS Congo)
